items.title: Mobile Health Screening
items.description: Fully equipped mobile clinical vans bringing rapid point-of-care laboratory tests, blood pressure, glucose, BMI, and ECG to remote and peri-urban populations.
items.homeDescription: Mobile clinics bring blood pressure, glucose and other point-of-care checks closer to communities.
scope: Blood Pressure & Mean Arterial Pressure monitoring
Random & Fasting Blood Glucose (POC Glucometry)
Point-of-care Lipid Panel & HbA1c
Portable 12-lead Electrocardiogram (ECG)
Body Mass Index & Visceral Adiposity assessment
items.audience: Rural community gatherings, market squares, faith-based institutions, and underserved peri-urban wards.
items.turnaround: Immediate results on-site with clinician counselling (15-20 minutes).

items.title: Community Health Outreach
items.description: Grassroots door-to-door community health initiatives, family health profiling, and liaison with village executive officers (VEOs) and Ward Health Committees.
items.homeDescription: Household visits, local health education and coordinated support through village and ward networks.
scope: Household sanitation & vector breeding audits
Maternal danger signs surveillance and antenatal tracking
Malnutrition mid-upper arm circumference (MUAC) screening in under-5s
Defaulter tracing for chronic disease and vaccination regimens
items.audience: Vulnerable households, isolated hamlets, elderly citizens with mobility restrictions.
items.turnaround: Continuous village monitoring with bi-weekly outreach rounds.

items.title: Clinical and Specialist Services
items.description: Temporary specialty field clinics staffed by visiting cardiologists, pediatricians, obstetricians, and ophthalmologists addressing advanced medical diagnoses.
items.homeDescription: Visiting specialists provide consultations, diagnostic reviews and links to further care.
scope: Obstetric & Abdominal Ultrasound sonography
Cervical Cancer Visual Inspection with Acetic Acid (VIA)
Specialist Pediatric review for congenital conditions
Ophthalmic slit-lamp exams and cataract identification
items.audience: Referred patients from initial community screening needing secondary specialist review.
items.turnaround: Specialist consultation and ultrasound report issued same day with direct hospital referral letter.

items.title: Rehabilitation and Inclusive Care
items.description: Targeted support for persons with disabilities, pediatric cerebral palsy, post-stroke motor impairment, and assistive device fitting.
items.homeDescription: Mobility assessments, assistive devices and caregiver support for people with disabilities.
scope: Functional motor capacity and mobility evaluations
Custom fitting of wheelchairs, crutches, and white canes
Home-based physical therapy coaching for primary caregivers
Hearing impairment audiometry baseline testing
items.audience: Persons living with physical or sensory disabilities, stroke survivors, and disabled youth.
items.turnaround: Initial functional assessment with custom assistive device allocation and home exercise plan.

items.title: Health Education & Public Communication
items.description: Evidence-based health promotion campaigns using local vernacular languages, public townhalls, community radio dramas, and interactive Q&A sessions.
items.homeDescription: Accessible health messages through local languages, community radio and public conversations.
scope: Dietary sodium and saturated fat reduction workshops
Tobacco & shisha cessation advocacy
Breast and testicular self-examination coaching
Misinformation refutation around chronic disease treatment
items.audience: General public, women groups, local market associations, and boda-boda rider unions.
items.turnaround: Multi-week ongoing behavioral change campaigns and weekly radio episodes.

items.title: Workplace and Institutional Wellness
items.description: Occupational health audits, ergonomic risk assessments, and structured health screenings tailored for corporate teams, civil service workers, and industrial facilities.
items.homeDescription: Preventive screening and practical wellbeing programmes for teams, workplaces and institutions.
scope: Comprehensive corporate executive health profiles
Ergonomic workspace assessment & repetitive strain injury prevention
Workplace mental health and burnout resilience workshops
Annual OSHA-compliant worker medical surveillance
items.audience: Corporates, public sector parastatals, manufacturing factories, and educational institutions.
equipment: Audiometric Booths for Factory Floor Noise Screening
items.turnaround: Corporate aggregate health index report delivered within 7 working days (anonymized data).

items.title: Research and Technical Collaboration
items.description: Rigorous epidemiological field data collection, bio-statistical modeling, and partnership with academic research institutes investigating non-communicable diseases in Africa.
items.homeDescription: Field research, health data and academic partnerships that inform community health programmes.
scope: Community-level NCD prevalence estimation protocols
Digital health surveillance with geo-referenced ward mapping
Qualitative health access barrier assessments
Collaborative peer-reviewed manuscript development
items.audience: Universities, international health consortiums, National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR).
items.turnaround: Quarterly surveillance bulletins and multi-year collaborative grant projects.

items.title: Public Health Training & Capacity Building
items.description: Accredited modular training modules for Community Health Workers (CHWs), dispensary nurses, and youth peer health champions.
items.homeDescription: Practical training and continuing support for community health workers and frontline teams.
scope: Standardized diagnostic triage and referral criteria
Blood pressure measurement precision and error minimization
Compassionate communication and patient counseling
Mobile application data entry and real-time synchronisation
items.audience: Ward Health Officers, Village Health Workers, student nurses, and peer educators.
items.turnaround: 5-day intensive certificate courses with post-training field supervision.
